one_line: Last major Satavahana king of the Deccan coasts, ruling over trade-rich hubs like Kanheri, Nasik and Nagarjunakonda.

appearance.face: oval face, warm medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, sharp but kind dark eyes with thick brows, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, default expression calm and focused with a hint of commanding resolve
appearance.hair: black hair parted in the middle, drawn back and tied into a compact low bun at the nape, front kept smooth; a simple golden cylindrical crown-band with incised geometric motifs rests above the forehead, holding a narrow red cloth strip that wraps beneath it like a headband
appearance.costume: Upper body in a finely draped off‑white cotton uttariya worn over both shoulders and across the chest in clean layered folds, leaving no bare torso; beneath it a fitted short‑sleeved reddish‑maroon tunic peeks at the neck and sleeves; lower body in a mustard‑yellow cotton dhoti with a slightly flared, ankle‑length wrap, pleated in front and drawn snug at the waist with a broad golden cloth belt; a second narrow saffron sash falls asymmetrically over the left hip; jewellery limited to a pair of medium gold disc earrings, a triple‑strand gold necklace of small beads, and two plain gold armlets high on the biceps over the uttariya; simple dark brown leather sandals with thong straps and a low sole; overall look clean, practical and court‑ready, evoking early historic Deccan royal attire without extravagance.
appearance.signature: A detailed palm‑sized copper coin held between right thumb and forefinger, showing a stylised ship with raised prow and stern, the coin’s rim slightly worn, symbolising his maritime‑aware rule and coastal trade networks.

ref_desc: Yajna Sri Śātakarṇi is a mid‑30s, medium‑brown Deccan king with an oval face, short beard, black hair in a low bun held by a golden crown‑band, wearing off‑white uttariya, maroon tunic, mustard dhoti, saffron sash, modest gold jewellery, and holding a copper ship‑coin, in off‑white, maroon, mustard, saffron and gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of Yajna Sri Śātakarṇi: a mid‑30s Deccan king with an oval face, medium‑brown complexion, sharp dark eyes, straight nose and neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, black hair parted and pulled into a compact low bun. On his head sits a simple cylindrical golden crown‑band with incised geometric patterns, anchored by a narrow red cloth strip like a headband. He wears an off‑white cotton uttariya draped over both shoulders and across his chest in layered folds, covering the torso completely, over a subtly visible short‑sleeved reddish‑maroon tunic. His lower garment is an ankle‑length mustard‑yellow cotton dhoti, pleated at the front and wrapped securely around the waist, held by a broad golden cloth belt, with a narrow saffron sash hanging asymmetrically from his left hip. Add modest gold disc earrings, a triple‑strand small‑bead gold necklace, and plain gold armlets on his upper arms over the uttariya, plus dark brown leather sandals. In his right hand he delicately holds a palm‑sized copper coin showing a stylised ship, clearly visible as his signature prop. Keep the design dignified, historically grounded to early historic Deccan royalty, using off‑white, reddish maroon, mustard yellow, saffron and gold as dominant colours, shown from multiple angles to make the face, hair, garments and coin consistently recognizable.
